strings.name: Denis Mukwege
strings.summary: Raised in Bukavu and medically trained in Burundi and France, Mukwege founded Panzi Hospital in 1999. His team combines surgery, psychological, legal and socioeconomic support for survivors of wartime sexual violence, while he challenges impunity. He survived an assassination attempt in 2012 and shared the 2018 Nobel Peace Prize with Murad. He ran unsuccessfully for the Congolese presidency in 2023.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Provides medical care to survivors of wartime sexual violence and promotes international accountability; his Nobel Peace Prize helped shape the global human-rights agenda.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Bukavu, then Belgian Congo, now the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Medical training, University of Burundi; obstetrics and gynaecology specialisation, Angers, France.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Holistic care
strings.highlights.h1.text: Panzi’s team combines medical, psychological, legal and socioeconomic support.
strings.highlights.h2.title: International accountability
strings.highlights.h2.text: Opposes conflict-related sexual violence and impunity; awarded the 2018 Nobel Peace Prize.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Presidential election
strings.timeline.t1.text: Ran as an independent candidate in the DRC and was not elected.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Nobel Peace Prize
strings.timeline.t2.text: Shared the award with Nadia Murad for opposing wartime sexual violence.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Sakharov Prize
strings.timeline.t3.text: The European Parliament recognised his protection of sexual-violence survivors.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Right Livelihood Award
strings.timeline.t4.text: Honoured for medical care and exposing wartime sexual violence’s causes.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Survived assassination attempt
strings.timeline.t5.text: He and his family survived; he returned after a short exile.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Founded Panzi Hospital
strings.timeline.t6.text: Established a Bukavu hospital that developed holistic survivor care.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completed medical degree
strings.timeline.t7.text: Graduated in Burundi before specialising in France.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Bukavu
strings.timeline.t8.text: Grew up in eastern Congo and later chose medicine.
